structure: Upload Button (Owner only, absolute bottom-right of cover)
Avatar Container (Absolute, centered, bottom: -53 of cover)
Stats Row (Card with 4 columns: SpotYou, Avis, Services, Abonnés)

implementation_steps: 1. Update the 'profile' state to include 'cover_url', 'followers_count', 'following_count' (mock if missing).
3. Replace the existing 'st.hero' View with the new layout.
4. Update StyleSheet 'st' with new classes provided below.

code_snippets.hero_jsx:
<View style={st.hero} testID="user-profile-hero">
          {/* COVER PHOTO */}
          <View style={st.coverContainer}>
            {profile.cover_url ? (
              <Image source={{ uri: profile.cover_url }} style={st.coverImage} />
            ) : (
              <View style={st.coverPlaceholder} />
            )}
            {isOwnProfile && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={st.coverUploadBtn} testID="cover-upload-btn">
                <Ionicons name="camera" size={20} color="#FFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* AVATAR (Absolute) */}
          <View style={st.avatarAbsoluteWrap}>
            <Image 
              source={{ uri: profile.picture || 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?background=0D8ABC&color=fff&size=128' }} 
              style={st.avatarImage} 
            />
            {profile.is_coach_verified && (
              <View style={st.verifiedBadge}>
                <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color="#0A0A0A" />
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* CONTENT BELOW COVER */}
          <View style={st.profileContent}>
            {/* Name */}
            <Text style={st.profileName} testID="user-profile-name">{profile.name}</Text>

            {/* Badges */}
            <View style={st.badgesRow}>
              {isCoach && (
                <View style={st.badgeCoach}>
                  <Ionicons name="trophy" size={12} color="#00BFA5" />
                  <Text style={st.badgeCoachText}>Coach</Text>
                </View>
              )}
              {avgRating != null && (
                <View style={st.badgeRating} testID="rating-badge">
                  <Ionicons name="star" size={12} color="#FFD700" />
                  <Text style={st.badgeRatingText}>{avgRating} ({reviews.length})</Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>

            {/* Bio */}
            {profile.bio ? <Text style={st.profileBio}>{profile.bio}</Text> : null}

            {/* Follow Button (Visitor) */}
            {!isOwnProfile && (
              <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[st.followBtn, isFollowing ? st.followBtnActive : {}]} 
                onPress={() => setIsFollowing(!isFollowing)}
                testID="follow-btn"
              >
                <Text style={[st.followBtnText, isFollowing ? st.followBtnTextActive : {}]}>
                  {isFollowing ? 'Abonné' : 'Suivre'}
                </Text>
                {isFollowing && <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color="#00BFA5" />}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}

            {/* Stats Row */}
            <View style={st.statsCard}>
              <View style={st.statCol}>
                <Text style={st.statVal}>{SpotYou.length}</Text>
                <Text style={st.statLabel}>SpotYou</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={st.statDivider} />
              <View style={st.statCol}>
                <Text style={st.statVal}>{reviews.length}</Text>
                <Text style={st.statLabel}>Avis</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={st.statDivider} />
              <View style={st.statCol}>
                <Text style={st.statVal}>{services.length}</Text>
                <Text style={st.statLabel}>Services</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={st.statDivider} />
              <View style={st.statCol}>
                <Text style={st.statVal}>{profile.followers_count || 0}</Text>
                <Text style={st.statLabel}>Abonnés</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
